description:
Archive the app-issue-tracker scenario after swarm-manager has achieved feature parity AND every consuming scenario has been hard-cutover off it.

## Context

App-issue-tracker was created to track and spawn coding agents to fix issues discovered in other scenarios. Swarm-manager has evolved into a strictly more capable system covering ideas, research, chores, and execution tasks with a richer workshop model, initiative grouping, and graph visualization.

## Pre-Deprecation Checklist

1. **Provenance tracking** (via agent identity standard): swarm-manager tracks who/what created each backlog item with verified identity.
2. **Concurrency / rate limiting** (via concurrency guardrails): swarm-manager has configurable concurrency limits, queue depth, and circuit breaker.
3. **Search and discovery** (via sidebar search): swarm-manager has search, filtering, and tabbed navigation.
4. **One-shot investigation flow**: swarm-manager's queue → execute flow with workshop-optional fast paths covers AIT's investigate endpoint.
5. **All consumers cut over**: app-monitor verified hard-cutover, and every other scenario swept (see `execute/app-monitor-issue-tracker-cutover-verify` and `execute/cross-scenario-issue-tracker-cutover-sweep`). Hard cutover only — no compat shims, no fallbacks, no dead code anywhere in the repo.

## Deliverables

1. **Extract reusable patterns** before removal: automation processor concept (background loop auto-picking open items) → design note for swarm-manager auto-processing; Tool Discovery Protocol v1.0 → API contract note; export format templates (CSV/markdown) → swarm-manager multi-format export note.
2. **Archive the scenario** using the established archive pattern (similar to archive-and-remove-legacy-vrooli-bridge).
3. **Repo-wide sweep**: confirm `rg 'app-issue-tracker'` is empty outside `scenarios/app-issue-tracker/` and removal-history docs. Update CLAUDE.md, memory files, prompt-manager team docs (oss-advertiser SOUL etc.), and `swarm-manager/requirements/18-app-issue-tracker-integration/module.json`.
4. **Verify nothing references AIT at runtime** — service.json depends_on across all scenarios, env wiring, deployment manifests, postgres seed (`vrooli-orchestrator/initialization/postgres/seed.sql`).

title: Deprecate and Archive the App-Issue-Tracker Scenario
